thread:
jamal: Hey folks / first-day intro — I'm Jamal joining as Product Designer on Growth. Quick list of blockers: 1) can't duplicate tokens from Platform UI in Figma (locked), 2) where's the concise roadmap + experiment tracker, 3) how do I get access to recent user session recordings for investigation, 4) who to ping for a design buddy. TL;DR: perms, docs, research access, buddy?

keiko: welcome Jamal! :tada: For Figma tokens it's usually a library publish setting. DM the file URL and your redwood email and i'll loop in design-ops. Also join #design-system — we post token updates there.

maya: hi Jamal  Maya from design-ops. Drop the Figma url and i'll check the publish flags. If components are "locked" i'll flip duplication for Growth team. Also confirm whether you need edit or just duplicate.

jamal: file: https://www.figma.com/file/PLAT-TOKENS/platform-ui-tokens ; email: jamal@redwood.com. Need to duplicate and make a small variant for an experiment.

maya: invited Growth team to the Platform UI file and allowed duplication. If you still see locks try logging out of Figma and back in (SSO caveat).

jamal: can duplicate now, thanks! / next: roadmap + experiments — where's the short version I can scan?

robbie: hey Jamal  Robbie (PM Lead for Growth). Short roadmap is at Notion: Product > Roadmap (top page has the 90-day bullets). Experiment tracker links to Jira tickets; we keep a simple table called "Active Experiments" with owner, metric, and link. I'll add you as commenter.

jamal: perfect — can you add me to the experiment table? want to see recent A/B setups.

robbie: added you. Short note: look for experiment tags `growth-activation` and `growth-onboarding`. If you want a walkthrough i'll book 30m.

jamal: will take the walkthrough. Research recordings — is there a central place for session videos and consent artifacts?

research-bot: Research Library: prototypes, session recordings, transcriptions available at https://redwood.notion.site/Research-Library. For access request open the Research Access form and tag @research-ops. Note: recordings contain PII redaction notes.

keiko: and for quick access to highlights we keep a "Research Clips" folder (short clips + timestamps) in the Research Library. For anything with raw audio you must sign the data handling agreement (Research Ops will automate that).

jamal: i'll request access. also — is there a standard interview / observation template you use so i can code notes consistently?

maya: templates are in Research Playbook (Notion)  there's a "5-minute clip + insight card" template we like for quick handoffs to PMs/Eng. If you want i'll drop a starter card for the onboarding experiment.

jamal: that'd be super helpful. last bit: buddy/mentorship for design onboarding? i find pairing helps get context faster.

keiko: we do a New Hire Buddy program. i'll assign you a senior designer as buddy and schedule 30m intro + a "first-week pairing" slot where you shadow a product crit. Expect invites today.

onboarding-bot: Jamal added to: Product Team, Design - Growth, Design System Access group. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: confirm Figma access, join crits, request Research Library access).

jamal: awesome  thanks all for the quick turnaround. i'll join Tues design crit and will post a first-draft of the experiment screens in #prod-design-review for feedback.

keiko: welcome aboard again  and ping me if you want a rapid tour of the component library later today.

jamal: will do / thanks everyone!
